name: Review Highlights / Themes
summary: Native list of target-supplied review themes and optional counts with passive neutral presentation and explicit target-owned navigation or selection projections.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered list containing the target-supplied review-theme collection; an optional localized name may identify it.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item preserving one theme and its optional count as a related unit; the child theme surface is its CSS contract anchor.

anatomy.name: tag
anatomy.description: Theme surface rendered as passive text by default or projected by a target as a truthful native link or button.

anatomy.name: count
anatomy.description: Optional visible target-formatted count whose accessible text includes the target-owned unit or context.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional localized accessible name for the native themes list when surrounding content does not already identify it.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned repeated native list items containing theme surfaces and optional counts; item mode and result synchronization are not implied.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Default wrapping native theme collection; semantic item mode remains target-owned.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Compact passive themes with touch-sized native interactive projections.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive native list with no interaction or selection state.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback for an available unselected native target action.

states.name: itemFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a native link or button projection.

states.name: projectedSelection
states.description: Shared visual projection for either a target-owned pressed button or a truthful current navigation link.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: The neutral structure is one unordered native list with one list item per theme. Explicit list role preserves the relationship when visual list markers are removed.

behavior.name: itemModeBoundary
behavior.description: The shared neutral fixture is passive. A target may project native links or buttons only after choosing navigation or in-place selection; the component does not infer filtering, selection cardinality, URLs, result updates or announcements from pill styling.

behavior.name: toggleProjection
behavior.description: A target-owned in-place selection uses a native button with a stable label and projected pressed state. Static authoring or the target owns initial state, request reconciliation, reset and persistence; Review Highlights adds no neutral state runtime.

behavior.name: navigationProjection
behavior.description: A navigation target supplies a real URL and may expose truthful current-destination state. Review Highlights does not own history, routing, loading or destination focus.

behavior.name: countOwnership
behavior.description: Visible counts, accessible units, formatting, freshness and synchronization are supplied by the target/provider rather than calculated or announced by this component.

behavior.name: emptyCollection
behavior.description: An empty native list is structurally valid. A surrounding review/results owner supplies any visible empty explanation instead of Review Highlights inventing one.

accessibility: Render the collection as a native unordered list with native list items and preserve list semantics when visual markers are removed.
Use passive text for the neutral fixture, a native link with a real URL for navigation, or a native button for target-owned in-place selection.
Expose toggle selection with aria-pressed and a stable button label; use aria-current only for a truthful current navigation destination.
Do not use a semanticless active class, pointer behavior, focus treatment or action-sized geometry on passive theme text.
Keep every optional count inside its theme item and provide an accessible target-localized unit or context rather than exposing a bare ambiguous number.
A target-owned results controller handles loading, empty results, focus and complete localized status announcements without making Review Highlights a live region.

web.notes: Native list/list-item anatomy, passive shared presentation and truthful native link/button state hooks are implemented without neutral component JavaScript or motion.

shopify.notes: A future review-provider theme app block supplies taxonomy, localized counts and any URLs/actions while consuming generated Gallery CSS; no provider-free Liquid is implied.
